fields.name: Fantasy
fields.description: Stories set in imaginary worlds where magic and mythical creatures are central.

fields.name: Science Fiction
fields.description: Speculative stories built on science, future technology, space, or alternate realities.

fields.name: Mystery
fields.description: A puzzle-driven plot, usually a crime or disappearance, solved by a detective or amateur sleuth.

fields.name: Thriller
fields.description: Fast-paced stories of tension and high stakes, where characters face constant danger.

fields.name: Horror
fields.description: Fiction designed to frighten and unsettle, often through the supernatural or psychological dread.

fields.name: Romance
fields.description: Stories focused on a love relationship, typically with an emotionally satisfying ending.

fields.name: Historical Fiction
fields.description: Fictional stories set in a real past era, with accurate period detail.

fields.name: Literary Fiction
fields.description: Character-driven, stylistically ambitious works that explore human experience and social themes.

fields.name: Contemporary Fiction
fields.description: Realistic stories set in the present day, dealing with modern life and relationships.

fields.name: Adventure
fields.description: Action-oriented stories of journeys, exploration, and survival in dangerous settings.

fields.name: Dystopian
fields.description: Stories set in oppressive, flawed societies, often warning about political or technological trends.

fields.name: Young Adult
fields.description: Fiction written for teenagers, centered on coming-of-age themes such as identity and first love.

fields.name: Children's Literature
fields.description: Books for young readers, using simple language, illustrations, and age-appropriate lessons.

fields.name: Crime
fields.description: Stories that follow criminals, investigators, or the justice system, often with a grittier tone.

fields.name: Western
fields.description: Tales set in the American frontier, featuring cowboys, outlaws, and the struggle between law and lawlessness.

fields.name: Biography
fields.description: The true story of a person's life, written by someone else or by the subject themselves.

fields.name: Memoir
fields.description: A personal account focused on specific experiences or periods in the author's life.

fields.name: History
fields.description: Non-fiction that researches and narrates real past events, people, and societies.

fields.name: Self-Help
fields.description: Practical non-fiction offering advice on personal growth, habits, and wellbeing.

fields.name: Science & Technology
fields.description: Non-fiction that explains scientific and technical subjects for a general audience.
